The '''Absit system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Tunka sector/Legends|Tunka sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] which contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Absit]].
